sources.label: Official Acne Studios size guide (Body measurements › Woman Tops, cm; Size conversion › Woman Tops)

audit: Old URL /en/size-guide is gone; guide is now /uk/en/help/size-guide.html. Woman Tops body chart (regular fit) printed as single values. Old figures were 1–5 cm low across the board: XS bust 78 → 80, waist 59 → 64, hips 83 → 88; M 86/67/91 → 88/72/96; XL 95/76/100 → 96/80/104. Added 30 and 32 (both labelled XXS by Acne; UK 2 and 4). Labels now Acne's own 'EU / letter' (two XXS sizes). UK/US from Acne's Woman Tops size conversion. Acne also publishes a separate 'Woman Tops (oversized)' chart with ranged sizes (e.g. XS/S = 76–80 chest), not stored.
